name: blindpay
description: Read-only view of your BlindPay stablecoin payment operations: payouts, payins, transfers, wallets, customers, bank accounts, fees, limits and payment rails.

interface.longDescription:
Check your BlindPay stablecoin payment operations without leaving ChatGPT. Look up payouts, payins and transfers and their status, see wallet balances and yield, review customers, bank accounts and virtual accounts, and check fees, limits and the payment rails available in each country.

Sign in with your BlindPay account and pick the instance you want to query. The plugin only reads data: it cannot send payouts, move funds or change any setting. It is made for teams already using BlindPay who want quick answers about their payment activity.
capabilities: Look up payouts, payins and transfers
defaultPrompt: List my payouts from the last 7 days grouped by status.
Which payout rails and bank details does BlindPay support for Brazil?
Show my wallets and their current balances.

positive.prompt: List the payouts on my instance and group them by status.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the instance's payouts with id, amount, currency and status, grouped by status.

positive.prompt: Show the details and current status of my most recent payout.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the newest payout, then return its amounts, recipient bank account, status and tracking steps.

positive.description: Payout rails and PIX bank details
positive.prompt: Use the BlindPay app: list the payout rails BlindPay supports, then get the bank details required for the PIX rail.
positive.expected_behavior: List every supported payout rail with its country, then the bank details PIX requires (the PIX key) and its validation rules.

positive.prompt: Use the BlindPay app to list the blockchain wallets of my first two customers, with network and address.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the first two customers, then list each one's blockchain wallets with name, network and address.

positive.prompt: Use the BlindPay app to list my customers and the bank accounts of the first customer.
positive.expected_behavior: List the instance's customers with country and KYC status, then the first customer's bank accounts with rail, status and account details.

negative.prompt: Use the BlindPay app to send 500 USDC to my customer Emma Williams' bank account.
Create a new customer named Maria Silva.

review.commerce_description: This plugin only reads payment data. It does not sell products, initiate payments or move funds.

publication.release_notes: Ask ChatGPT about your BlindPay account: payouts and their status, customers and their bank accounts, blockchain wallets, and the payout rails BlindPay supports with the bank details each one needs. Read-only: it can't send money or change anything in your account.
